input.subject: KPC-2026-014: Clarifications needed on your offer (RM-002 density and documents)
input.body:
Dear Mr. Selvam,

Thank you for your offer and the propanediol COA. We need the following to complete our evaluation.

1. RM-002 Glycerin (vegetable, IP grade): your offer quotes per litre with no density. Please state the density in g/mL at a stated temperature, and the net kg per litre so we can convert the quote to kilograms.
2. Certificate of Analysis for each line (RM-001 to RM-010), showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. The propanediol COA is received; the other nine are still needed.
3. Current Safety Data Sheet for each line (RM-001 to RM-010), including the transport hazard class.
4. Conversion from your selling unit to kilograms of net material for each line (for example, 1 drum = 200 kg net). A completed Annexure A meets this requirement.
5. Confirm whether you are the manufacturer for each line. If not, name the manufacturer and country of manufacture.
6. Confirm whether you can meet the first need-by date of 20 December 2026. If not, state your earliest date for the first delivery.
7. State your on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate for these lines over the last 12 months, with your definition of on-time.
8. State your payment terms and any price escalation clause, including any links to currency or raw material indices.

Please reply in the RFx format where possible, or use the attached questionnaire. Responses are due by 8 November 2026.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
